morphology.pattern_note: 词根为表示礼貌邀请的 sila；dipersilakan 是 mempersilakan 的被动形式，并非独立词根。各部分直接连接，无鼻音同化；标准拼写只有一个 l。

senses.zh_definition: 被礼貌地邀请或请去进行某项活动；常用于“敬请入座、进场、发言”等正式邀请。
senses.en_definition: Be respectfully invited or requested to do something; used in courteous invitations and announcements.
senses.ms_definition: Dijemput atau diminta dengan hormat untuk melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 形式上是被动动词，交际上常承担礼貌邀请功能，如 Para tetamu dipersilakan duduk。可以鼓励对方接受邀请，但不等同于授予正式许可的 dibenarkan。词义依据 [DBP PRPM：sila](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=sila)。

collocations.en: be invited to take a seat
be invited to address the audience

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Para tetamu dipersilakan mengambil tempat sebelum majlis bermula.
dual_scenarios.zh: 敬请各位来宾在典礼开始前入座。
dual_scenarios.en: Guests are kindly invited to take their seats before the ceremony begins.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah sampai? Dipersilakan masuk, jangan malu-malu lah!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sudah sampai? Anda dipersilakan masuk; usahlah berasa segan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 到了呀？快请进，别客气啦！
dual_scenarios.en: You're here? Come on in—don't be shy!
spoken_features: lah 增添亲切、劝请的语气
省略主语的 dipersilakan 带有热情或略显俏皮的正式感

messages.speaker: Aina (主人)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah sampai? Dipersilakan masuk, jangan malu-malu lah!
messages.ms_standard: Sudah sampai? Anda dipersilakan masuk; usahlah berasa segan.
messages.zh: 到了呀？快请进，别客气啦！
messages.en: You're here? Come on in—don't be shy!

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Terima kasih! Aku nak letak kasut kat luar dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Terima kasih! Saya hendak meletakkan kasut di luar dahulu.
messages.zh: 谢谢！我先把鞋放在外面。
messages.en: Thanks! I'll leave my shoes outside first.

etymology.historical_story: Dipersilakan grows from the courteous invitation word sila through Malay passive morphology. Its cultural force is easy to hear when an emcee invites guests to sit or a host welcomes someone inside. DBP lists this invitation word separately from sila meaning cross-legged sitting and sila referring to moral conduct; identical spelling alone does not establish a shared origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 sila＝“请”，再套上 diper-…-kan：某人“受到礼貌邀请”，就是 dipersilakan。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合司仪、接待人员及主人礼貌邀请来宾；搭配适当称谓，如 Puan dipersilakan masuk，可体现尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 典礼、会议、接待和待客场合常见。熟人闲聊中较正式，可能带亲切的仪式感；一般可用 sila 或 jemput。对王室成员应遵循相应王室礼仪用语。
